businessProblem: J.C. Penney is implementing a full-chain strategic repositioning in early 2012: moving from promotional/coupon pricing to everyday low pricing, rebranding to JCP, and redesigning stores. The strategy targets a customer base that is historically promo-sensitive. No pilot testing disclosed. Risk of immediate traffic and conversion loss if core customers do not respond. Diagnose main risks and recommend highest-priority action plan.

evidence.finding: J.C. Penney's existing customer base is highly accustomed to promotional pricing, coupons, and discount events — behavior change required by new strategy is significant
evidence.source: HBS Working Knowledge analysis, public strategy announcements

evidence.finding: New everyday low pricing strategy being rolled out across the full chain simultaneously — no disclosed phased or pilot approach
evidence.source: Company announcements early 2012, HBS Working Knowledge

evidence.finding: Strategy involves simultaneous changes: pricing model, brand name (to JCP), and store redesign — compounding execution risk
Customer price perception may not shift immediately from 'sale price' to 'everyday price' — cognitive repricing takes time and communication investment
evidence.source: Pricing strategy analysis, HBS Working Knowledge, Paddle pricing analysis

evidence.finding: New CEO Ron Johnson imported strategy from Apple retail — applicability to J.C. Penney's customer segment and department store format carries transfer risk
Traffic and conversion risk is chain-wide from day one — no control stores to measure impact separately
No publicly disclosed real-time customer response monitoring or rollback plan — strategic optionality appears limited
evidence.source: Public reporting, absence of disclosed pilot framework

evidence.finding: Department store competitive environment requires clear value communication — simplified pricing must be perceived as value, not price reduction removal

clientContext.primaryStakeholder: CEO, Board, merchandising and marketing leadership

ownerConstraintProfile.followThroughRisk: HIGH — full commitment to unproven strategy without rollback plan
ownerConstraintProfile.managementCapability: UNCERTAIN — new leadership with untested strategy transfer
ownerConstraintProfile.accountabilityWeakness: HIGH — no disclosed customer feedback monitoring or performance triggers
